crumbs.page: Submit a PDF or image review

title: Submit a cosmetic ad pre-review
description:
Upload a PDF or image, and AI analyzes the copy and photos separately.
Each phrase gets candidate legal articles. Your reviewer decides legality.

fromAlert.title: Product details loaded from an earlier review
fromAlert.text: Loaded the product details and channels of '{name}'. Upload the revised ad to submit it as a new review.

ad.title: 3. Ad creatives
ad.fileHint: Up to 25 MiB per file, 5 ad files, 75 MiB in total. Uploaded originals are kept on the server with the results.
ad.dropDescription: Print posters, online banners, product pages (JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF). Copy and photos are analyzed separately. Selected ads are sent to the OpenAI API for analysis.

applicant.title: 1. Applicant
applicant.companyHint: Filled in from your account's company.
applicant.name: Contact
applicant.emailHint: From your account. Email sending is not implemented.

evidence.title: 4. Evidence documents
evidence.aside: Optional, the extracted text is shown for checking
evidence.intro: Optionally submit test data or product documents you have. This version extracts the document text; matching product and test conditions and recommending documents per claim come later.
evidence.dropTitle: Drag evidence files here or choose them
evidence.dropDescription: Reviews, reports, ingredient lists, human or in-vitro test reports, certificates, patents, trademark registrations, certificates of origin (PDF, JPG, PNG)
evidence.note: Until legal search is connected, submitted documents alone do not settle whether the ad is legal or sufficiently substantiated.

requirement.prohibited: Not allowed with evidence, change the copy
requirement.prohibitedText: Drug-like or expert-endorsement claims cannot be justified with evidence.

product.title: 2. Product
product.aside: Choose the product this ad is for
product.searchPlaceholder: Search by product name or choose from the list
product.noResults: No matching products. Try another name or add a product.
product.selectHint: Change the product name and type on the product page.
product.none: No products yet. Add a product first.

credit.topUpNote: Your product details are saved as a draft. Upload your files again after topping up.
credit.loadFailed: Could not load credit information. Please try again shortly.
credit.insufficient: This review requires {count} credits. Please top up first.
credit.insufficientUpdated: You do not have enough credits. Check your balance and top up.
credit.note: Credits are deducted when the review starts and returned automatically if analysis fails.
credit.confirmLead: These credits are deducted and analysis starts right away.

draft.loaded: Your draft is loaded. Continue where you left off.
draft.missing: This draft could not be found. Its review may have started, or it was saved in another browser.
draft.productRequired: Choose a product before saving a draft.
draft.saveFailed: Could not save the draft. Check your browser storage.
draft.savedText: Continue any time from the product page
